scripts.build: npm run build:app && npm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace apps/app exec -- tsc --noEmit && npm --workspace apps/web exec -- tsc --noEmit
scripts.lint: npm --workspace apps/app exec -- eslint . && npm --workspace apps/web run lint
scripts.check: npm run lint:migrations && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
